summary: 48 items audited. Whole tree nuts (almond, walnut, pecan, cashew, pistachio, hazelnut, macadamia, brazil, pine, peanut, chestnut) and the major seeds (sesame, sunflower, pumpkin, chia, flax, hemp, poppy, nigella, melon/egusi) are present and mostly well-formed with good regional aliases (groundnut, pepitas, linseed, kalonji). The category is, however, lopsided: it spends a lot of items on flavored corn-nut SKUs (bbq/chile-lime/ranch/original) and near-duplicate seed-form children (striped/black-oilseed sunflower, white/black chia, three melon-seed children) while almost entirely missing nut & seed BUTTERS and nut FLOURS/MEALS as Nuts & Seeds items. Almond butter, cashew butter, peanut butter, and tahini are NOT in this category at all (peanut butter and tahini live in Condiments & Sauces; almond flour and marzipan live in Baking & Sweeteners), so the only butters here are macadamia-nut-butter, mixed-nut butter, and a generic nut-butter. There are also several true duplicates (nigella-sativa vs nigella-seed; egusi/egusi-seed/watermelon-seed overlap; oriental-poppy duplicating poppy-seed; corn nuts arguably belong in Snacks rather than Nuts & Seeds), a 'ground nut' alias collision between the generic 'nut' and 'peanut', and a couple of dietary-tag errors (whole nuts wrongly tagged Nut-Free; white-chia-seed wrongly aliased 'white poppy seed'). Recommended: add the missing butters and flours/meals, add high-value global nuts/seeds (tigernut, pili, candlenut, ground/raw peanut variants, water-caltrop), fix the Nut-Free tagging, and de-duplicate the nigella/egusi/poppy clusters.
issues: Whole tree nuts that are common allergens are incorrectly NOT tagged Nut-Free in most cases (good), but several non-nut items here are correctly Nut-Free; meanwhile 'mixed-nuts nut' (mixed nuts) is tagged Nut-Free — that is wrong, mixed nuts contain tree nuts and usually peanuts.

'nut' (the generic parent) is tagged Nut-Free and carries alias 'ground nut'. A generic 'nut' is by definition NOT nut-free, and 'ground nut' is the British/African word for peanut, so the alias belongs on 'peanut', not on the generic 'nut'. This causes a collision: both 'nut' and 'peanut' effectively claim groundnut.

'white chia seed' carries the alias 'white poppy seed' — these are two completely different ingredients (white poppy / khus-khus is used in Indian cooking; white chia is a chia color morph). The alias is a data error and will mis-resolve recipes.

Nut/seed butters are badly under-represented as Nuts & Seeds items: almond butter, cashew butter, hazelnut butter, peanut butter, sunflower seed butter (sunbutter), pumpkin seed butter, and tahini are all either missing or filed under other categories (peanut butter + tahini in Condiments & Sauces). Only macadamia-nut-butter, mixed-nut butter, and generic nut-butter exist here.

Nut/seed flours & meals are absent from this category. Almond flour lives in Baking & Sweeteners; there is no hazelnut meal, pecan meal, walnut meal, pistachio flour, ground/LSA seed mix, defatted peanut/peanut flour, or sesame flour represented as a Nuts & Seeds item.

Corn nut and its flavor children (bbq/chile-lime/ranch/original corn nut) are mis-categorized: corn nuts are toasted corn kernels (a snack), not a nut or seed. They inflate this category and are arguably a Snacks/Grains item. Flagged, not auto-moved.

Form/variety children are inconsistently modeled: sunflower has 'striped' and 'black oilseed' children, sesame has an 'unhulled' child, chia has white/black children, melon seed has cantaloupe/honeydew/watermelon/egusi children — but the far more common forms (raw vs roasted vs salted, blanched vs unblanched, shelled vs in-shell) are not modeled for almonds, cashews, pistachios, peanuts, etc. The granularity is uneven.

Several common global/specialty nuts and seeds are missing entirely: tigernut (chufa), pili nut, candlenut (kemiri/kukui), water caltrop (singhara), baru seed, sacha inchi, kola nut, betel/areca nut, and tree-nut staples like raw vs roasted peanut are not split out.

Storage modeling: many high-oil items (pecan, walnut, pine nut, peanut, hazelnut) correctly have shorter Pantry windows and longer Refrigerated/Frozen windows, which is good. But lotus-seed has an odd Refrigerated window of [30,60] while Pantry is [365,730] — refrigerated should not be SHORTER than pantry for a dry seed; likely a data slip.
redundancies: Identical item: nigella sativa IS nigella seed (kalonji / black cumin). Same aliases, same freshness, same tags. nigella-sativa is just the Latin binomial of nigella-seed. Keep nigella-seed (the common name), fold the binomial into its aliases, delete nigella-sativa.

Two egusi entries: 'egusi melon seed' (child of melon seed) and standalone 'egusi seed'. Egusi is a single West-African ingredient (ground melon seed). Keep one (prefer 'egusi-seed' as the recognized standalone name) and make it a child of melon seed; delete the other.

Overlap: watermelon-seed lists alias 'egusi' and egusi is botanically Citrullus lanatus (wild watermelon/melon seed). They are closely related but culinarily distinct (egusi = a specific gourd seed used ground in stew; watermelon seed = snack/kernel). Keep both but remove the cross 'egusi' alias from watermelon-seed to avoid mis-resolution.

'oriental poppy seed' duplicates poppy-seed: identical aliases (khus khus, poppy seeds) and freshness. Oriental poppy (Papaver orientale) is in fact NOT a food seed source; this looks like a spurious child. Fold into poppy-seed (or drop), and model the real culinary split as blue vs white poppy seed instead.

Near-duplicate generic butters: 'nut butter' (generic, alias 'tree nut butter') and 'mixed nut butter' largely overlap in meaning. Keep generic 'nut-butter' as the parent and treat 'mixed nut butter' as a child of it (or merge).

Granularity duplication: cantaloupe/honeydew melon-seed children add little value over the 'melon seed' parent for a pantry app; if trimming, collapse the rarely-stocked cantaloupe/honeydew children into the melon-seed parent. (Listed as a low-priority consolidation, not a hard dup.)

newItems.name: almond butter
newItems.notes: Major nut butter missing from this category. Natural (no stabilizer) lasts ~3-5 mo pantry, 6-9 mo refrigerated; refrigeration recommended once opened.

newItems.name: cashew butter
newItems.notes: Follows same storage rules as almond/macadamia butter per source guidance.

newItems.name: hazelnut butter
newItems.notes: Pure hazelnut butter (not sweetened chocolate-hazelnut spread, which is a separate confection).

newItems.name: peanut butter
newItems.notes: Currently only exists in Condiments & Sauces. Add a Nuts & Seeds canonical entry (or relocate) so it lives with its parent 'nut butter'. Stabilized commercial PB lasts longer at pantry than natural.

newItems.name: tahini
newItems.notes: Sesame seed butter. Currently only in Condiments & Sauces. Seed-based so it IS Nut-Free. Add canonical Nuts & Seeds entry; could also parent under sesame-seed.

newItems.name: sunflower seed butter
newItems.notes: Popular Nut-Free PB alternative for allergy households. ~6 mo unopened; refrigerate after opening (1-6 mo).

newItems.name: pumpkin seed butter
newItems.notes: Seed butter; Nut-Free. Up to ~12 mo unopened cool/dark; 3-6 mo refrigerated after opening.

newItems.name: almond meal
newItems.notes: Almond flour currently only in Baking & Sweeteners; add as a Nuts & Seeds child of almond so nut-flour recipes resolve. High-oil so shorter pantry life than wheat flour.

newItems.name: hazelnut meal
newItems.notes: Used in dacquoise, financiers, gluten-free baking.

newItems.name: peanut flour
newItems.notes: Defatted, so longer shelf life than oily nut meals; common protein/baking ingredient and West-African thickener.

newItems.name: tigernut
newItems.notes: Not a true nut (a tuber); Nut-Free, allergy-friendly. Basis of Spanish horchata de chufa and West-African snacks. Dried tigernuts keep up to 2 years cool/dry; ~6-12 mo once opened.

newItems.name: pili nut
newItems.notes: Filipino tree nut, very high oil so best refrigerated/frozen for max shelf life. Popular keto snack.

newItems.name: candlenut
newItems.notes: SE Asian (Indonesian/Malaysian) culinary thickener; must be cooked (mildly toxic raw). ~1 year+ airtight cool/dark. Note: not eaten as a snack.

newItems.name: sacha inchi seed
newItems.notes: South American omega-3-rich seed, sold dry-roasted as a high-protein snack; not a true nut.

newItems.name: baru seed
newItems.notes: Brazilian Cerrado legume seed eaten dry-roasted; marketed as a nut-free snack. ~18-24 mo sealed cool/dry.

newItems.name: water caltrop
newItems.notes: South/East-Asian aquatic seed (Trapa); fresh is perishable, also sold dried/as singhara flour. Distinct from the Chinese water chestnut corm.

newItems.name: white poppy seed
newItems.notes: Indian-cuisine poppy seed (thickener for kormas/posto). Resolves the bad 'white poppy seed' alias currently misplaced on white-chia-seed; replaces the spurious 'oriental poppy seed' child.

newItems.name: roasted salted peanut
newItems.notes: Roasting + salt extends pantry life vs raw peanut; very common snack form worth modeling as a child.

newItems.name: kola nut
newItems.notes: West-African caffeine-bearing seed used ceremonially and as a flavoring; fresh nuts are perishable, dried keep longer.

newItems.name: LSA seed mix
newItems.notes: Common ground linseed-sunflower-almond mix (Australia/NZ); ground & high-oil so oxidizes fast — best refrigerated/frozen. Contains almond so NOT Nut-Free.

cleanups.fix: Remove the 'Nut-Free' dietary tag — mixed nuts contain tree nuts (and usually peanuts) and are a top allergen. Also rename display from 'mixed nuts nut' to 'mixed nuts'.
Remove 'Nut-Free' tag (a generic 'nut' is not nut-free) and remove the 'ground nut' alias (that's peanut/groundnut; move it to the 'peanut' item). Keep as the abstract parent only.
Remove the alias 'white poppy seed' — it is a different ingredient (added separately as its own item). White chia should only alias chia-related terms.
Delete as duplicate of nigella-seed; fold 'nigella sativa' into nigella-seed's aliases.
Delete 'oriental poppy seed' (spurious; oriental poppy is ornamental, not a culinary seed). Replace with proper blue/white poppy seed split; fold any aliases into poppy-seed.
Resolve egusi duplication: keep one egusi entry (prefer 'egusi-seed'), parent it under melon seed, delete the other.
Remove the 'egusi' alias to avoid collapsing watermelon-seed (snack kernel) into egusi (ground-seed stew base); keep them distinct.

Fix freshness: Refrigerated [30,60] is shorter than Pantry [365,730] for a dry seed; refrigerated should be >= pantry (e.g. Refrigerated [365,730], Frozen [730,1095]). The 30-60 value likely belongs to fresh lotus seed only.

Reconsider category: corn nuts (and bbq/chile-lime/ranch/original children) are toasted corn snacks, not nuts/seeds. Recommend moving to Snacks (or Grains & Cereals). Flag only — do not auto-move without product sign-off.
Re-parent under generic 'nut-butter' (currently parent is 'nut butter' which is correct — confirm the parentId points to the nut-butter id, not a stray). Keep.
